name: the-sweep-knows-every-progress-file
replace:
return UUID(uuidString: stem)
            ?? (stem.hasSuffix("-media") ? UUID(uuidString: String(stem.dropLast(6))) : nil)
breaks: the sweep goes back to a hand written suffix list, which is the form that had already drifted: it knew the caption and media names while ocrProgressFile had been writing <uuid>-ocr.json since #467, so every OCR progress file of every deleted event stayed on disk forever. A reader listing what it recognises exempts whatever it forgot from the check meant to catch it (#1128, L96, L41)
